task_instruction: Improve the code harness so every solve attempt must produce a real file edit or patch, run at least one relevant validation command when available, record changed_files and commands_run in result.json, and retry once after a failed validation with the error message added to context.

Improve the data-analysis harness so it cannot finish with a template-only report. It must execute analysis code, write quantitative tables into REPORT.md, emit analysis_summary.json with concrete numeric fields, and fall back to a simple baseline computation when advanced modeling fails.
